transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Confirmed by 三立新聞: SpaceX plans to raise 40 billion USD to buy NVIDIA chips, with Apollo leading the financing by 2027.
NVIDIA launches RTX Spark laptops on October 16 and unveils DGX Station for Windows, reported by HardwareZone Singapore, with trillion-parameter artificial intelligence support.
Still open per 經濟日報: Broadcom is rumored to raise over 50 billion USD for OpenAI, following similar major chip financing deals.
DeepSeek doubles its funding target to 15 billion dollars ahead of a 2027 IPO, reported by Mint, with 160,000 Huawei artificial intelligence accelerators planned.
Reported by 36Kr: DeepSeek raised up to 1 trillion yuan in financing after its R1 model outperformed rivals with low costs.
